# Vendored classify_scalar

`classify_scalar.hpp` is an unchanged copy pinned to an upstream commit. Do not
patch the vendored header directly. Make and test fixes in
[`vincentlaucsb/classify_scalar`](https://github.com/vincentlaucsb/classify_scalar)
first, following its [vendoring guidance](https://github.com/vincentlaucsb/classify_scalar#maintaining-vendored-releases).
Then use the sync and verification procedure in [README.md](README.md) to
import the approved upstream tag or commit.
